Per-Feature-Normalized Metric

Source: R/distance_metrics.R
per_feature_metric.Rd

Divides a base metric's value by \(d^{power}\) (\(d\) = number of shared IDs), turning a joint quantity into a per-feature rate that stays roughly constant (rather than growing/collapsing) as \(d\) changes under a constant per-feature effect. Forwards requires_shared_kernel/is_symmetric_metric to the wrapped metric.

Usage

per_feature_metric(base, power)

Arguments

base

A distance_metric object to normalize.

power

The exponent applied to \(d\) (e.g. 0.5 for \(\sqrt d\), 1 for \(d\)).

Value

A distance_metric object.
